business_type: Service Area Business (SAB) — Leaflet & Flyer Distribution

summary.business_type: Service Area Business — Leaflet Distribution, Hampshire & Dorset UK
top_findings: No phone number anywhere on the site — present on 0/13 pages vs 10/10 ranking competitors
Zero customer testimonials or social proof anywhere
Business is entirely anonymous — no named founder, director, or team member
No AI crawler management in robots.txt
Schema entity graph broken — no @id on LocalBusiness, Services not linked to entity
quick_wins: Add @id to LocalBusiness schema (5 min, unlocks entity graph)
Add WebSite JSON-LD to layout.tsx (15 min)
Add AI crawler rules to robots.ts (15 min)
Fix lang='en' to lang='en-GB' in layout.tsx (5 min)
Fix sitemap lastModified from new Date() to static dates (20 min)
Remove fonts.gstatic.com from CSP font-src (5 min)
Update 4 generic page title tags to include geo context (20 min)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All critical SEO content in initial HTML — no JS rendering dependency
HTTPS + HSTS (max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload)
All 5 security headers correctly implemented
Clean URL structure (lowercase, hyphenated, no query strings)
Canonical tags present on all pages
Sitemap valid with 12 URLs, /blog correctly excluded
noindex on /blog confirmed in built HTML
OG/Twitter cards on all pages
Inter font self-hosted via next/font (no external runtime request)

findings.title: No AI crawler management in robots.txt
findings.description: All AI training crawlers (GPTBot, CCBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Bytespider) freely allowed via wildcard rule.
findings.recommendation: Add named rules to robots.ts: block CCBot, GPTBot, Bytespider, Google-Extended; allow PerplexityBot and ChatGPT-User for search referral traffic.

findings.title: IndexNow not implemented
findings.description: No IndexNow key file. Near-instant indexing on Bing and Yandex not available.
findings.recommendation: Generate a hex key, place at /public/<key>.txt, POST changed URLs on deploy.

findings.title: Duplicate canonical tags on every page
findings.description: Confirmed in built HTML: both metadata.alternates.canonical and JSX <link rel='canonical'> rendering simultaneously — 2 identical tags per page.
findings.recommendation: Remove JSX <link rel='canonical'> from all 13 page component return values. metadata.alternates.canonical now rendering correctly in Next.js 16.2.6.

findings.title: Sitemap lastModified: new Date() — build timestamp for all URLs
findings.description: Every URL gets the same build timestamp as lastmod. Google ignores inaccurate lastmod.
findings.recommendation: Replace new Date() with static per-route ISO date strings in sitemap.ts.

findings.title: CSP uses script-src 'unsafe-inline'
findings.description: Negates XSS protection for inline scripts.
findings.recommendation: Short-term acceptable for Next.js. Long-term: implement nonce-based CSP via Next.js middleware.

findings.title: picsum.photos in remotePatterns — unused
findings.description: Stale configuration entry. No page uses Picsum images.
findings.recommendation: Remove from next.config.ts remotePatterns.

findings.title: Services-page image dimension mismatch — CLS risk
findings.description: Package cards: width={700} height={420} overridden by CSS h-56. Supporting services: width={600} height={300} overridden by h-44. Browser reserves wrong space → layout shift.
findings.recommendation: Replace with fill prop + fixed-height wrapper div.

findings.title: lang='en' should be lang='en-GB'
findings.description: Incorrect language tag for a UK-specific business.
findings.recommendation: Change html element lang attribute to en-GB in app/layout.tsx.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: FAQ page: 620 words, 10 substantive Q&As, strongest page on the site
Postcode-level specificity on all area pages
Correct Hampshire vs Dorset administrative geography throughout
Neighbourhood naming (Shirley, Westbourne, Sandbanks, St Cross, Lyndhurst)
Service format specificity (A4/A5/A6/DL) consistently stated

findings.title: Business is entirely anonymous
findings.description: No named founder, director, or team member anywhere. Primary Trust gap under September 2025 QRG.
findings.recommendation: Name the business owner on the About page with a 2–3 sentence bio and founding year.

findings.title: Zero social proof
findings.description: No testimonials, no reviews, no star rating, no case studies anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Collect 3–5 genuine testimonials; embed on homepage and About page.

findings.title: 9 of 12 active pages below word count minimum
findings.description: Services (~410 words vs 800+ needed), About (~270 vs 500+), all 6 area pages (~200–270 vs 500+), Areas hub (~220 vs 500+).
findings.recommendation: Expand each page with unique local context, process narrative, and business-use cases.

findings.title: Services page content duplicates homepage cards
findings.description: Service descriptions are near word-for-word copies of homepage cards. Zero unique informational value.
findings.recommendation: Add How It Works, per-service 'who it suits' copy, turnaround times, minimum quantities.

findings.title: No pricing signals anywhere
findings.description: Not a single pricing reference across any page or FAQ answer.
findings.recommendation: Add 'from £X per 1,000 leaflets' or a pricing range to homepage and services page.

findings.title: FAQ missing 3 high-intent questions
findings.description: Pricing, tracking proof, and leaflet exclusivity are the top PAA queries for this vertical — all absent.
findings.recommendation: Add: 'How much does leaflet distribution cost in Hampshire?', 'How do I know my leaflets were delivered?', 'Are my leaflets delivered alone or shared?'

findings.title: Internal linking weak outside /quote
findings.description: Every page links to /quote. But /services doesn't link to /areas; area pages don't cross-link; /faq and /about have no links to area pages.
findings.recommendation: Add cross-links: area pages → adjacent areas; /faq answers → area pages; /services → /areas.

categories.name: On-Page SEO / SXO
what_works: H1 tags keyword-rich and correctly placed on all pages
Clear conversion path to /quote from every page
Responsive design, mobile-friendly
Quote form detailed and well-structured
City page structure (correct page type for city-level queries)

findings.title: Zero competitive trust elements present
findings.description: Phone number (0/13 pages), testimonials (0 pages), delivery proof mechanism (0 pages), pricing (0 pages), 'How It Works' section (0 pages), volume stats (0 pages). All present on 7–10/10 ranking competitors.
findings.recommendation: Implement in order: phone number → testimonials → pricing signal → How It Works → volume stats.

findings.title: City area pages severely under-resourced vs ranking pages
findings.description: Southampton page: ~250 words. Top-ranking competitor city pages: 600–1,200 words with testimonials, process steps, FAQs, and delivery proof.
findings.recommendation: Expand to 600+ words. Add local context, process narrative, 4 inline FAQs, at least one testimonial.

findings.title: No 'How It Works' process section
findings.description: Present on 8/10 ranking competitors. Absent from homepage, services page, and all area pages.
findings.recommendation: Add a 4-step process block: Enquiry → Area review → Distribution → Confirmation.

findings.title: Delivery tracking claim is vague
findings.description: 'Tracked and Assured Delivery' trust panel provides no mechanism detail. Competitors explicitly name GPS tracking, completion reports, or photo confirmation.
findings.recommendation: Specify exactly what tracking involves in the trust panel copy and on area pages.

findings.title: Blog placeholder undermines site completeness
findings.description: 'Coming soon' label in footer nav signals incomplete site to both users and crawlers.
findings.recommendation: Launch blog with 3–5 posts or remove from navigation until ready.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: FAQPage schema correctly implemented with all 10 Q&As
BreadcrumbList correctly on /areas and all 6 area sub-pages
Service @graph with 6 nodes on /services
LocalBusiness with areaServed on homepage
All schemas use https://schema.org context, no syntax errors

findings.title: LocalBusiness missing @id — entity graph broken
findings.description: Without a stable @id, Google cannot associate citations, Service nodes, or GBP signals with this entity.
findings.recommendation: Add "@id": "https://flyerdistributionhampshire.co.uk/#business" to LocalBusiness. 20-minute fix, maximum impact.

findings.title: LocalBusiness @type is bare LocalBusiness
findings.description: ProfessionalService subtype provides stronger classification signals for this service category.
findings.recommendation: Change to ["LocalBusiness", "ProfessionalService"].

findings.title: No WebSite schema in layout.tsx
findings.description: No global WebSite entity linking publisher to website.
findings.recommendation: Add WebSite JSON-LD to layout.tsx with publisher @id reference.

findings.title: Service nodes have no @id — cannot be cross-referenced
findings.description: Six services are unlinked entities. No hasOfferCatalog on LocalBusiness.
findings.recommendation: Add @id to each Service node (e.g. ...#design-print-deliver), update provider to use {"@id": ".../#business"}, add hasOfferCatalog to LocalBusiness.

findings.title: Area pages have only BreadcrumbList schema
findings.description: High-intent landing pages with zero entity signal beyond navigation.
findings.recommendation: Add Service node scoped to each city on each area page.

findings.title: areaServed uses plain strings
findings.description: Flat string array provides keyword matching but not geographic entity anchoring.
findings.recommendation: Replace with typed City/AdministrativeArea objects.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: priority prop on hero image (preload link confirmed in built HTML)
INP very likely to pass — minimal client-side JS, no heavy event handlers
Bundle size excellent — only Next.js, React, React-DOM
No render-blocking third-party scripts
Font self-hosted via next/font (no external request)
AVIF/WebP image optimization active

findings.title: Hero image cross-origin Unsplash fetch — LCP risk
findings.description: Cold-fetch from Unsplash origin adds 300ms–1500ms to LCP on cache miss.
findings.recommendation: Self-host or serve from a CDN. Current /_next/image proxy helps but doesn't eliminate origin latency on cold requests.

findings.title: Services-page image dimension mismatch — CLS
findings.description: CSS height overrides declared width/height attributes — browser shifts layout on image load.
findings.recommendation: Use fill prop + fixed-height wrapper div on all services-page images.

findings.title: transform: scale(1.2) on hero Image element
findings.description: CSS transform on LCP image forces compositing layer, adds 50–150ms paint delay.
findings.recommendation: Move transform to a wrapper div, not the Image element itself.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Full SSR — AI crawlers receive complete HTML without JS execution
FAQPage schema correctly implemented
llms.txt created and deployed during this audit
Specific postcode lists and neighbourhood names are AI-citable facts
Minimum quantity (5,000) and turnaround time (2 weeks) are citable operational claims

findings.title: No pricing information — most-requested AI query unanswered
findings.description: AI assistants asked 'how much does leaflet distribution in Hampshire cost?' have nothing to cite.
findings.recommendation: Add pricing FAQ answer. Even 'from £X per 1,000 leaflets' makes this site AI-citable for the highest commercial-value query.

findings.title: FAQ answers below optimal AI citation length
findings.description: Most answers are 40–75 words. Optimal AI citation range is 120–160 words with the direct answer first.
findings.recommendation: Expand each FAQ answer by 30–50% while keeping the direct answer in sentence 1.

findings.title: Brand mention signals near-zero
findings.description: sameAs has only the GBP link. No Wikipedia, YouTube, Reddit, LinkedIn. AI citation models weight third-party co-occurrence heavily.
findings.recommendation: Add LinkedIn Company Page. Submit to Yell.com and FreeIndex. Add those URLs to sameAs.

categories.name: Local SEO
what_works: GBP sameAs link in LocalBusiness schema
GBP 'Find us on Google' link in footer with branded icon
Name perfectly consistent across all sources
Address deliberately omitted (correct for SAB)
Postcode-level specificity on area pages

findings.title: Zero reviews or social proof
findings.description: No testimonials, no star rating, no aggregateRating schema. Whitespark 2026: review velocity is top-3 local pack factor.
findings.recommendation: Set up post-campaign review request email. Target 2+ new Google reviews per month.

findings.title: No phone number
findings.description: Primary local conversion mechanism. Click-to-call dominant on mobile. Required for local pack 'call' actions.
findings.recommendation: Add phone number to header, footer, About, Quote, and LocalBusiness schema.

findings.title: No citation directory presence
findings.description: No listings on any Tier 1 UK directories (Yell, Thomson Local, FreeIndex, Scoot, Yelp UK).
findings.recommendation: Submit to all five within 2 weeks. ~2.5 hours total. NAP: 'Flyer Distribution Hampshire' + email + URL.

findings.title: GBP share link may not be stable
findings.description: https://share.google/RVxyPi4TzXAzkt1Am is a shortlink, not a permanent Place URL.
findings.recommendation: Replace with canonical Google Maps Place URL from GBP dashboard.

categories.name: Sitemap & Architecture
what_works: All 12 indexable pages in sitemap
/blog correctly excluded (noindex, follow)
Clean URL structure throughout
All pages within 2 clicks of homepage
robots.txt valid and references sitemap

findings.title: lastModified: new Date() — identical timestamp for all URLs
findings.description: Google ignores inaccurate lastmod. All URLs show the same build timestamp.
findings.recommendation: Replace with static per-route ISO date strings in sitemap.ts.

findings.title: Area pages don't cross-link to siblings or /services
findings.description: Internal linking outside of /quote is weak. Area pages are orphaned from the services cluster.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Nearby areas' and 'Our services' link blocks to each area page.
